areas.rides: One OP_RETURN note on the transaction that spends the dog, after the seller's payment output.
One tag on the transaction that pays for a post or profile: an OP_RETURN note on a DOGE payment, or the ds field of a DRC-20 transfer.
LAUNCH_DEPLOY is the inscribed collection record. LAUNCH_MINT is the tag on the buyer's mint transaction.
The inscription is the decision: an application/json body with ds beside the rules.
Proof anchors and refunds from Doge Soft services.
